# Paths whose credential-shaped strings are known to be synthetic.
#
# One exact path per line. Paths are matched from the repository root; nothing
# else is exempt. Do not add a source file, workflow, .env or report here - if a
# real credential is found, rotate it and clean the history instead.
#
# tests/unit/test_db_dsn.py, tests/unit/test_staging_mode.py
#   Unit tests for DSN parsing and staging/production identity checks. They must
#   contain complete postgres:// URLs to exercise the parser; the hosts, users
#   and passwords in them are invented. Earlier revisions of these fixtures are
#   also present in the commit history.
#
# tests/unit/test_settings_placeholders.py
#   Asserts that a credential-shaped value is *kept* rather than mistaken for a
#   placeholder. Earlier revisions used a synthetic `sk-free-...` string that the
#   shape rules (correctly) flag in the commit history.
tests/unit/test_db_dsn.py
tests/unit/test_staging_mode.py
tests/unit/test_settings_placeholders.py
